focus: hooks and runtime safety: install, trust gate, per-gate config, preflight advisory, message gate, doctor backend
answeredQuestions: What runtime knobs gate sk-git enforcement (hook trust, per-gate config, advisory suppression, install state)?

label: Global hooks are .skilled/scripts/git-hooks/ sources symlinked into git rev-parse --git-path hooks by install-git-hooks.sh (honoring local/global core.hooksPath, usually machine-wide); --status reports scope, per-hook resolution, SHADOWED warnings, and the resolved message contract

Install safety already exists: foreign-hook ownership check (symlink must resolve under .skilled/.opencode scripts/git-hooks), warn-and-skip, --uninstall removes only own links, linked-worktree dangling-symlink warning — coexistence with husky/pre-commit/lefthook is designed

skilled.trustRepoHooks (local config only, never -c/GIT_CONFIG_*/cloned) decides whether globally installed hooks run the repo's own gate scripts; untrusted -> SOURCE_ROOT=/dev/null/.skilled-untrusted, NOTICE names the enable command; trust covers repo not branch

commit-msg is outside the trust block: validator found beside the installed hook enforces the target repo's own rules block even untrusted, no bypass; --no-verify only defers to pre-push+CI — the one enforcement trust cannot escape

gates.tsv is the single per-gate registry (13 persistable gates + remotePush/massDeletion non-persistable); gate-config.sh reads speckit.hooks.<key> local/global (off|false|no|0); /doctor:git hooks = git-hook-gates.cjs list|set dry-run-default exit 0/2

Kill switches at three levels: SYSTEM_HOOKS_DISABLED/SYSTEM_GIT_COMMIT_HOOKS_DISABLED master flags, per-concern env (git-preflight -> SK_GIT_PREFLIGHT_DISABLED), per-gate SPECKIT_SKIP_*/config — a setup check reading only hook files misses flag silence

Preflight advisory = PreToolUse hook reading hard-rules.json via dispatch-rule-checks.mjs, MAX_ADVISORIES=3, fail-open everywhere, SKGIT_ADVISORY=0/SKGIT_ADVISORY_SKIP suppression; three runtime adapters (Claude mjs, opencode js, pi ts) mean registration per runtime is the real state, not file presence

git-message-gate.mjs is the agent-side commit-msg mirror: PreToolUse blocking on visible commit -m/-F, gh pr create/edit body, branch names; no suppression; one file serving Claude/Codex Bash, Devin exec, Cursor Shell envelopes — per-runtime registration check needed

Hooks setup-check failure taxonomy: absent/SHADOWED hook, foreign-hook skip, hooksPath scope mismatch, worktree dangling links, untrusted silent skip (commit-msg still blocks), disable-flag silence, unregistered runtime adapter, missing gate script exits 1 naming path+bypass

/doctor:git is a thin router in the sk-code shape (routes.yaml target+setup -> presentation contract -> workflow YAML in doctor/assets/); a setup target = one route row + workflow + read-only check script reusing git-standards status/git-hook-gates list/install --status
